description.text: Program Description Doctoral graduates should have profound basic theory of safety discipline, extensive safety discipline, professional knowledge and innovative senior talents with various abilities. Graduates should have a broad theoretical basis and systematic and in-depth expertise in modern mathematics, disaster control, safety engineering, industrial health and safety management. Can be creative in scientific research related to safety science and technology and design and management of major engineering safety. I have a deep and systematic understanding of the academic frontier, current situation and development trend of this discipline. Have a good command of at least one foreign language, can read the foreign language materials of this major skillfully, has certain writing ability of the thesis and the oral expression ability of international academic exchanges. After graduation, I can be engaged in teaching and research work in institutions of higher learning and scientific research institutions, or in high-level technical design, risk assessment and safety management work in industrial and mining enterprises and management departments. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Safety Science and Engineering at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Master's Degree or an equivalent 2.Two recommendations by two professors or associate professors 3.Pass of relevant examinations
